coverage: All50states plus DC where supported; presidential and midterm history
requirements: Actual numerical integration, not source inventories alone
Native versions, weights, response universes and joint-information qualification
Historical holdouts, simple baselines, source-based sensitivity and uncertainty
No state-to-local allocation without a qualified local model
No missing-as-zero or inferred death/migration/firstever voting
No private respondents or private fine cells published
Reconcile reported endpoints and units separately from behavioral eligibility

source_roles.role: Contest counts and separately qualified ballot/participation controls
Weighted source-frame demographic, participation and vote-choice associations
Comparable current-voter composition and actual joint-history checks; shared study partners not independent
Compatible population frames and district/county/precinct resident context, not observed voter attributes
Native stocks and qualified matched histories, preserving unknowns and cohort changes
